intro.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Brea, done by specialists
paragraphs: S&A Excellence Bathroom Remodeling handles bathroom remodeling in Brea, and bathrooms are its whole focus. Its Facebook page says it specializes in custom bathroom remodels that blend function with luxury, whether that means a sleek shower upgrade, elegant vanities or a full-scale remodel.

Clients describe the same things in different words: professional, efficient and attentive to detail. One homeowner said her outdated bathroom became a modern, stylish space she now loves. Another said the new bathroom feels like a spa retreat, built with high-quality materials and excellent craftsmanship. A third called the whole remodel a breeze from start to finish.

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From the initial consultation to the final touches, the team takes an outdated bathroom and turns it into a modern, stylish room. Clients describe the process as professional and efficient, with the finished space exceeding their expectations. Call to talk through your bathroom.

items.name: Shower upgrades
items.blurb: A sleek shower upgrade is one of the projects named on the S&A Excellence Facebook page. Whether you want to replace an old tub and shower combination or refresh a dated stall, ask about layout, tile and glass options for your space.

items.name: Vanities and custom cabinets
items.blurb: Elegant vanities are part of the work, and custom cabinets are listed among the services. A new vanity changes how a bathroom looks and how much it holds, so plan storage, counter space and sink layout as part of the remodel.

items.name: Bathroom flooring
items.blurb: Flooring is listed among the services, so the floor can be planned with the rest of the remodel instead of as an afterthought. Ask about materials that suit a wet room and match the look of your new shower and vanity.

about.text: S&A Excellence Bathroom Remodeling is a bathroom remodeler serving Brea, California. The team specializes in custom bathroom remodels that blend function with luxury, from shower upgrades and vanities to full-scale remodels, with custom cabinets and flooring as part of the work. Clients describe a skilled, easy-to-work-with team that handles each project from the initial consultation to the final touches. Every one of its 13 Google reviews gives five stars, and the reviews quoted below all describe bathrooms that turned out better than expected.

steps.title: Initial consultation
steps.text: Call (949) 850-6772 to talk about your bathroom, what bothers you about it now and what you want it to feel like.

steps.title: Design the room
steps.text: Choose the shower, vanity, cabinets, flooring and finishes together, so the new bathroom fits how you use it every day.

steps.title: Remodel
steps.text: The team does the work. Clients describe it as professional, efficient and attentive to their needs, with detail in every part of the project.

steps.title: Final touches
steps.text: The last details go in and you walk through the finished bathroom together, from the shower to the vanity hardware.

items.name: Ana V.
items.text: I recently had my bathroom remodeled and couldn't be happier with the results. The team was professional, efficient, and paid great attention to detail. They transformed my outdated bathroom into a modern, stylish space that I now love. The quality of their work exceeded my expectations, and I highly recommend their services.

Our new bathroom is stunning and feels like a spa retreat. I highly recommend them for anyone looking to upgrade their bathroom!
